text: The applicant was born in 1967.
The applicant lives in Kalinkovichi.
On 29 March 2008 the applicant was stopped by a Russian customs officer at the border crossing into Belarus.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: After checking the applicant's documents, the Russian customs officer informed the applicant that he had failed to declare his Opel car when entering Russia.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: The Russian customs officer informed the applicant that by failing to declare his Opel car when entering Russia, the applicant had infringed Russian customs regulations.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: The Russian customs officer instituted administrative proceedings against the applicant.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: The Russian customs officer impounded the applicant's Opel car.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On 11 June 2008 Colonel B., Head of the Novozybkov Customs Post of the Bryansk Customs Office, examined the applicant's case.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: Colonel B., Head of the Novozybkov Customs Post of the Bryansk Customs Office, found the applicant liable for having failed to declare his Opel car.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: Colonel B., Head of the Novozybkov Customs Post of the Bryansk Customs Office, ordered the applicant to pay a fine in the amount of 35,509.50 Russian roubles (RUB).
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: Colonel B., Head of the Novozybkov Customs Post of the Bryansk Customs Office, ruled that the applicant's Opel car, which had been impounded by customs, should be returned to the applicant.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: The applicant appealed against the decision of 11 June 2008 issued by Colonel B., Head of the Novozybkov Customs Post of the Bryansk Customs Office.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On an unspecified date the Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region fixed the hearing for 8 August 2008.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On 8 August 2008 the Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region examined the applicant's appeal against the decision of 11 June 2008.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On 8 August 2008 the Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region upheld the decision of 11 June 2008 issued by Colonel B., Head of the Novozybkov Customs Post of the Bryansk Customs Office.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: The Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region heard the case of 8 August 2008 in the applicant's absence.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: In the operative part of the judgment of 8 August 2008, the Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region advised the applicant of his right to appeal against that judgment.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: According to the applicant, the letter from the Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region notifying him of the date and time of the court hearing reached him on 9 August 2008.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On 26 September 2008 the applicant received a copy of the Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region's judgment of 8 August 2008 by post.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On an unspecified date the applicant lodged an appeal with the Bryansk Regional Court against the judgment of 8 August 2008.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On 13 November 2008 the Bryansk Regional Court sent a letter to the applicant informing him that his appeal was dismissed.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: The applicant submitted a request for supervisory review of the judgment of 8 August 2008.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On 26 January 2009 the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation dismissed the applicant's request for supervisory review.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On 20 August 2009 the Acting Head of the Novozybkov Customs Post of the Bryansk Customs Office discontinued the enforcement proceedings in respect of the decision of 11 June 2008.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: The Acting Head of the Novozybkov Customs Post of the Bryansk Customs Office noted that the applicant was a foreign national.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: The Acting Head of the Novozybkov Customs Post of the Bryansk Customs Office noted that the applicant had no assets in the Russian Federation.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: The Acting Head of the Novozybkov Customs Post of the Bryansk Customs Office noted that the applicant had no known place of residence in the Russian Federation.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: The Acting Head of the Novozybkov Customs Post of the Bryansk Customs Office noted that it was impossible to enforce the decision of 11 June 2008 on account of the expiry of the relevant time-limit.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On 24 August 2009 the Bryansk Customs certified that the decision concerning the applicant's administrative liability had come into force on 15 July 2009.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On 24 August 2009 the Bryansk Customs certified that the applicant had failed to reclaim his Opel car within a month of 15 July 2009.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On an unspecified date the regional agency in charge of the federal property applied to the Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region seeking to reclaim the applicant's Opel car as bona vacantia.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On 12 November 2009 the Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region granted the regional agency in charge of the federal property's claims in full regarding the applicant's Opel car.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: The Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region took into account that, as claimed by the regional agency in charge of the federal property, the applicant had been repeatedly summoned to the regional customs office to pick up his Opel car.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: According to the documents submitted by the Government, the Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region decided to hear the case of 12 November 2009 in the applicant's absence given that the applicant had been duly notified of the hearing and chose not to attend.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: The applicant did not appeal against the judgment of 12 November 2009 of the Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region.
section_path: A.  Impounding of the applicant's car

text: On 2 June 2010 the judgment of 12 November 2009 of the Novozybkov Town Court of the Bryansk Region was enforced.

text: On 19 March 2012 the leaders of the Strategy-31 movement notified the Mayor of Moscow of their intention to organise a rally at Triumfalnaya Square in the centre of Moscow on 31 March 2012 (Saturday), scheduled from 6 to 8 p.m.

On 19 March 2012 the leaders of the Strategy-31 movement notified the Mayor of Moscow of their intention to organise a march from Triumfalnaya Square down Tverskaya Street to Manezh Square on 31 March 2012 (Saturday), scheduled from 8 to 8.30 p.m.
Approximately 1,500 people were expected to attend the rally and march planned for 31 March 2012 by the leaders of the Strategy-31 movement.
The rally and march planned for 31 March 2012 were organised to promote the right to peaceful assembly as set forth in Article 31 of the Constitution of the Russian Federation.
The rally and march planned for 31 March 2012 were organised to promote the freedom of Parliamentary elections in Russia.
On 20 March 2012 the Government of Moscow refused to agree on the venues for the rally and the march planned for 31 March 2012.
According to the Moscow authorities, there was archaeological and construction work going on in Triumfalnaya Square at the time of the planned rally.

According to the Moscow authorities, the march along the indicated route from Triumfalnaya Square down Tverskaya Street to Manezh Square would disrupt the normal functioning of the city's infrastructure and traffic.

According to the Moscow authorities, the march along the indicated route from Triumfalnaya Square down Tverskaya Street to Manezh Square would infringe the rights and interests of people who would not take part in the rally and the march.
The Moscow authorities suggested two alternative venues for the planned rally and march of 31 March 2012, both located in the centre of Moscow.
On 29 March 2012 the leaders of the Strategy-31 movement informed the Mayor of Moscow that the rally would take place at Triumfalnaya Square as indicated in their notification of 19 March 2012.
On 31 March 2012 the rally was held as planned by its organisers at Triumfalnaya Square in Moscow.
The applicant took part in the rally held on 31 March 2012 at Triumfalnaya Square in Moscow.
At 6.30 p.m. on 31 March 2012 the applicant was arrested and brought to the police station.
According to the arrest record, the applicant had taken part in an unauthorised gathering on 31 March 2012.
According to the arrest record, the applicant chanted the slogan "Down with Putin" at the gathering on 31 March 2012.
According to the arrest record, the applicant chanted the slogan "Let us stop the dictatorship" at the gathering on 31 March 2012.
According to the arrest record, the applicant chanted the slogan "Fascism shall not pass" at the gathering on 31 March 2012.

On 17 April 2012 the Justice of the Peace of Precinct no. 367 of the Tverskoy District of Moscow found that the rally held on 31 March 2012 had been organised in contravention of the existing procedure.

On 17 April 2012 the Justice of the Peace of Precinct no. 367 of the Tverskoy District of Moscow found that the applicant had taken part in the rally of 31 March 2012 without having verified whether it had been legitimate.

On 17 April 2012 the Justice of the Peace of Precinct no. 367 of the Tverskoy District of Moscow found the applicant administratively liable for violation of the established procedure for organising a public assembly.
On 17 April 2012 the Justice of the Peace of Precinct no. 367 of the Tverskoy District of Moscow fined the applicant RUB 500.
The applicant appealed against the decision of 17 April 2012 of the Justice of the Peace of Precinct no. 367 of the Tverskoy District of Moscow.
On 21 May 2012 the Tverskoy District Court of Moscow upheld the decision of 17 April 2012 of the Justice of the Peace of Precinct no. 367 of the Tverskoy District of Moscow on appeal.
